cases.oracle: GNU coreutils cp in the same disposable guest; assertions also enforce the specified outcomes.
cases.purpose: Copy exact binary bytes to an existing FIFO with and without -f, preserving its inode and type.
cases.comparison: Compare status, output and remaining tree; explicitly assert both copy and bounded reader status, bytes, FIFO type and hardlink identity.
cases.script:
/usr/bin/timeout 8 /usr/bin/cat sink >received & reader=$!
if cp src sink; then copy_status=0; else copy_status=$?; fi
if wait "$reader"; then reader_status=0; else reader_status=$?; fi
[[ $copy_status == 0 && $reader_status == 0 && -p sink && sink -ef original ]] || exit 1
/usr/bin/cmp -s src received || exit 1
/usr/bin/rm received
/usr/bin/timeout 8 /usr/bin/cat sink >received & reader=$!
if cp -f src sink; then copy_status=0; else copy_status=$?; fi
if wait "$reader"; then reader_status=0; else reader_status=$?; fi
[[ $copy_status == 0 && $reader_status == 0 && -p sink && sink -ef original ]] || exit 1
/usr/bin/cmp -s src received || exit 1
/usr/bin/rm sink original received
printf 'fifo copies ok\n'

cases.oracle: GNU coreutils cp in the same disposable guest; assertions also enforce the specified outcomes.
cases.purpose: Copy to /dev/null and detect ENOSPC from /dev/full while preserving both device identities.
cases.comparison: Compare status, output and remaining tree; assert success, nonzero write failure with ENOSPC diagnostic and unchanged character-device identities. Diagnostic wording is not compared.
cases.script:
if cp src /dev/null; then :; else exit 1; fi
if cp -f src /dev/null; then :; else exit 1; fi
if cp src /dev/full 2>error; then exit 1; fi
/usr/bin/grep -F 'No space left on device' error >/dev/null || exit 1
/usr/bin/rm error
/usr/bin/python3 identity.py check || exit 1
printf 'device copies ok\n'
